generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government of Karnataka.

Tenders who fulfill the above specified minimum qualification criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under As per this notification
During the time of technical evaluation, if the employer finds that any certification / information furnished is false, such bidders will be disqualified and barred from participation in the bid.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work make themselves familiar with local situation about the availability of work men, etc before submission of bids.
Incomplete tender document will be rejected.
The contractors firm shall send the authorization letter for their representatives duly attesting their signature.
Typographical errors, if any will not ground for any claims by the contractor
The Bidder shall be responsible for successful performance of the contract.
The contractor/ authorized signatory should attach his/her scanned signature to the schedule B submitting their tenders
If any of the dates mentioned above happened to be a general holiday, the next working day holds good.
Further information can be had from the undersigned during office hours in the office of the executive engineer KBNJL FIC Div No.3 Almatti , Nidagundi Tq Dt. Vijayapur and also through e mail id
Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected the officers competent to accept the tender shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
Corrigendum will be published in the web site/ news papers for all modifications/ corrections if any.

In the case of contractor quotes the rates above 125% of the estimated rates, then the amount over and above 125% will be with held during the progress of works. In the case of contractor quotes the rates below estimated rates, then the difference amount of estimated and coated has to be furnished as additional performance security in the from of DD/Bank Guaranty during agreement the additional performance security will be released proportionately to the bill amount till the contractor achieves progress of entire work as per agreement.

The quoted premium shall include all taxes, and including GST Deductions will be made as per the norms and statutory order of Government at the time of making payment.Contractor should abide by the directions of Government towards recovery of 1% (or as modified by the Government from time to time) cess from the contractors bill under the provisions of building and other constructions works welfare cess Act 1996

The bidders may apply for one work or up to their tender capacity only. The preference work has to be uploaded if they are the lowest bidders. The works will be awarded as per their tender Capacity on order of preference.
During agreement the contractor has to submit security deposit of 5% to the bid cost with GST in the form of DD/B.G

As the works are to be completed within financial year (March-2027), the lowest bidder has to concluded agreement within 7 days with APS (If required) & security deposit . Failing which the EMD Reemitted will be for fitted and action will be initiated as per norms.

As per royalty charges is concerned, contractor should submit MDP for each material issued from mines and Geology department GOK. Otherwise penalty charges will be recovered as per Nigam Circular No.8708 Dt. 26.12.2023
